I'm **Nicholas Lloyd Smith**, a PhD student in the
[Department of Economics](https://economics.emory.edu) at Emory University.

## research

I'm an applied microeconomist interested in health and labor economics. I aim
to use causal inference methods to study risky behaviors, time use, and
policies that shape them.

A couple of projects in progress...

::: {.arrows}
- [Male Entry to Female-Dominated Occupations]{.wip}
- [Effects of Sports Gambling Legalization on Health Outcomes]{.wip}
:::
